test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

A. Some clothes are poems.

B. Poem is a tree.

**Conclusions:**

A. Poem is not a tree.

B. Some poems are clothes.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/938d443444dfca478390f2f1a92613c62d8eb49850e78c7d03656f28a87f18cd.png] 

Conclusions:

A. Poem is not a tree → Does not follow (As poem is a tree. As whole poems comes in trees, therefore it is false.)

B. Some poems are clothes → Follow (As some clothes are poems. As some part of poems is common with clothes, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion B follows.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
